headline: Miss Brazil Withdraws From Activities During Miss Universe 2026
seoTitle: Miss Brazil Misses Miss Universe 2026 Events
metaDescription: Miss Brazil Marcella Kozinski has paused pageant activities due to health concerns as the Miss Universe 2026 competition takes place in Puerto Rico.
aiSummaryBullets: Brazilian representative Marcella Kozinski withdrew from Miss Universe activities to undergo medical examinations.
The model is currently resting in Puerto Rico six days before the scheduled competition finale.
The 75th edition of the Miss Universe pageant currently features 116 contestants after several nations were excluded.
aiContextParagraph: The 75th edition of the Miss Universe pageant is currently being held in Puerto Rico, featuring a field of 116 confirmed candidates. As the event approaches its final stage, Brazilian contestant Marcella Kozinski, 26, has been forced to temporarily step away from the official schedule. According to reports, the representative required medical attention and was advised to rest during the evaluation period. Meanwhile, pageant organizers have confirmed that the final list of contestants excludes representatives from at least 20 countries that had previously been anticipated to participate or had already selected candidates for the global competition. The circumstances regarding the exclusion of these international delegates remain a point of focus alongside the ongoing developments regarding the health status of the Brazilian representative as the pageant nears its concluding ceremonies scheduled for the coming week.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to significant public search interest regarding the Miss Universe pageant and the sudden health updates of a national contestant.
